name: StyleTTS2
description: Human-level expressive TTS engine using style diffusion and adversarial training. Community server wrappers expose synthesis via Gradio (port 7860), FastAPI OpenAI-compat (port 8000), and bespoke REST APIs, uniformly without authentication by default.
auth_notes: No authentication in any default deployment across all known server implementations. Gradio offers an optional `auth=("user","pass")` kwarg but it is absent from every canonical deployment script found (Clore.ai guide, official HF space Dockerfile, lxe/tts-server). The ALERTua Ukrainian OpenAI-compat wrapper explicitly documents "You can leave the API key empty, as the endpoint does not check for it." SaladTechnologies POST /generate exposes synthesis with zero auth. No rate limiting present in any self-hosted configuration.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Matches Gradio instances using the canonical page title from the official HF space and most community forks. Port 7860 is the Gradio default.
Broader HTML body match on Gradio deployments that may customise the page title but retain the styletts2 string in page content or JS bundles.
Conjunctive match: canonical title plus Gradio product fingerprint. Eliminates port-squatters and reduces FP rate vs title-only queries.
Targets FastAPI/uvicorn OpenAI-compat deployments (ALERTua and similar wrappers) that serve the synthesis API on port 8000 alongside or independently of the Gradio UI.
Targets SaladTechnologies styletts2-api containers which expose /generate on port 4321 — distinct from the Gradio or OpenAI-compat port space.

known_vulns: No CVEs assigned as of August 2026.
Structural: zero authentication on all default server implementations (Gradio, FastAPI, Flask, SaladTechnologies API).
styletts2 PyPI package (v0.1.6) flagged as inactive/unmaintained — dependency chain unpatched.
Gradio queue endpoints (/queue/join, /queue/status) unauthenticated and abusable for GPU DoS via job flooding.
Reference audio upload (voice cloning path) has no file-type validation in community wrappers — potential path traversal in file handling code.
risk_notes: Unauth synthesis = free GPU compute theft at operator cost (A100/RTX inference is not cheap). Voice cloning: any caller can POST a reference audio file and receive a cloned voice synthesis — enables deepfake audio for fraud, social engineering, and vishing at zero marginal cost to attacker. Gradio queue system is unauthenticated and unbounded; flooding /queue/join starves legitimate use and can OOM the GPU host. Reference audio upload path in community wrappers lacks MIME/extension validation — path traversal or SSRF via crafted filenames plausible depending on implementation. No rate limiting in any self-hosted deployment reviewed. The `--share` flag in Gradio creates a publicly accessible tunnel (*.gradio.app) that bypasses firewall rules, expanding the exposure surface beyond the host network.
deployment_notes: Requires NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 11.8+). Canonical cloud deployment targets: Clore.ai GPU marketplace, Salad Technologies container engine, HuggingFace Spaces. Standard launch command `python3 app.py --share` (Clore.ai guide) exposes a public Gradio tunnel with no auth. Docker run maps port 7860 directly. The ALERTua Ukrainian OpenAI-compat stack runs two services: Gradio on port 7860 (GRADIO_PORT env) and uvicorn FastAPI on port 8000 (UVICORN_PORT env). SaladTechnologies image exposes port 4321. lxe/tts-server defaults to port 5000 via Flask with --host/--port flags. Model weights fetched from HuggingFace (yl4579/StyleTTS2-LibriTTS) at container start, not baked into image in most deployments.
